blocks.text:
UK regulator’s code of practice on streaming platforms is intended to give prominence to iPlayer and similar offerings

Public service broadcasters’ streaming services such as BBC iPlayer should appear first on app menus on smart TVs to give them an “appropriate degree of prominence”, according to Ofcom.

In addition, the regulator has said public service shows should rank higher on voice and text searches on televisions connected to the internet.
